insignia.note: Field uniform (Feldanzug): the olive rank slide (Aufschiebeschlaufe) over the shoulder strap, insignia embroidered in black. Devices per Anlage 2 of the Bundespraesident's uniform order (search extracts only, pages not opened): no insignia for the lowest rank; 1-4 diagonal stripes for Gefreiter to Stabsgefreiter; braid open at the bottom (Unteroffizier) or closed (Stabsunteroffizier); closed braid with one or two chevrons point up (Feldwebel, Oberfeldwebel) or a headed chevron (Hauptfeldwebel); one star per officer grade (Leutnant 1, Oberleutnant 2). The exact shape of the headed chevron and the stars is drawn from description, not from a picture.

note: Original colour choices (M7.5, docs/ASSETS.md): green tones in the spirit of a woodland camouflage (made greener at the owner's review, 2026-11-13); NATO-style green paint. Presentation only, outside the catalog.
